```{r module-7-sensitivity, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# Vary market, demand and pricing assumptions one scenario family at a time.
# Generate separate case-specific outputs using canonical module templates.

required_packages <- c( "tidyverse", "broom", "mgcv", "lpSolve" )
missing_packages <- required_packages[ !required_packages %in% rownames( installed.packages() ) ]
if ( length( missing_packages ) > 0L
) {
  stop( paste0( "Install the following packages before running Module 7: ", paste( missing_packages,
        collapse = ", " ) ) )
}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
})
options( dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE, scipen = 999 )
project_root <- normalizePath( getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE )
cat( "\nModule 7 project root: ", project_root, "\n", sep = "" )
config <- list( output_dir = file.path( project_root, "outputs", "sensitivity_analysis" ), cases_dir = file.path(
      project_root, "outputs", "sensitivity_analysis", "cases" ), module3_template =
    file.path(project_root, "03_construct_synthetic_quote_market.Rmd"), module4_template =
    file.path(project_root, "04_generate_conversion_outcomes.Rmd"), module5_template =
    file.path(project_root, "05_fit_conversion_models.Rmd"), module6_template =
    file.path(project_root, "06_constrained_pricing_simulation.Rmd"), expected_policy_year = 2025L,
  expected_profiles = 50000L, expected_conversion_train_rows = 30000L, expected_conversion_validation_rows = 10000L,
  expected_conversion_test_rows = 10000L, expected_module5_version = "M5-GLMGAM-OOT-2026-09-18",
  expected_module6_version = "M6-GLMGAM-OOT-2026-09-18", expected_conversion_model_families = c( "glm", "gam" ),
  expected_conversion_candidates = c( "Technical-only GLM", "Own-price GLM", "Relative-price GLM", "Rank GLM",
      "Market-position GLM", "Market-position GAM" ),
  cases_to_run = NULL,
  overwrite_existing_cases = FALSE,
  # Central robustness criteria.
  minimum_truth_margin_retention = 1.00, minimum_truth_conversion_uplift = 0.00,
  # Rate neutrality is judged on VALIDATION, where the targeted constraint is
  # imposed. TEST rate level is descriptive and never used to retune the strategy.
  development_rate_neutral_tolerance = 0.005, write_plots = TRUE )
dir.create(
  config$output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE )
dir.create(
  config$cases_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE )
# Fail early if the resolved absolute Module 7 output directory itself cannot
# create a new file.
write_probe_path <- file.path( config$output_dir, paste0( ".module7_write_probe_", Sys.getpid(), ".tmp" ) )
write_probe_connection <- tryCatch( file( write_probe_path, open = "w" ),
    error = function(e) {
      NULL
    } )
if ( is.null( write_probe_connection )
) {
  stop( paste0( "Module 7 cannot create files in its resolved output directory.\n", "Project root: ", project_root,
      "\n", "Resolved output directory: ", config$output_dir, "\n", "Current working directory: ", getwd(), "\n",
      "Directory exists: ", dir.exists( config$output_dir ), "\n", "file.access(write) result: ", file.access(
        config$output_dir, 2 ) ) )
}
close( write_probe_connection )
unlink( write_probe_path, force = TRUE )
assert_template_contains <- function( file_path, required_text, template_label
) {
  if ( !file.exists( file_path )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( template_label, " template not found: ", file_path ) )
  }
  template_text <- paste( readLines( file_path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8" ), collapse = "\n" )
  if ( !grepl( required_text, template_text, fixed = TRUE )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( template_label, " does not match the final GLM/GAM contract. Expected marker: ", required_text,
        ". Resolved file: ", file_path ) )
  }
  invisible( TRUE )
}
assert_template_contains( config$module5_template, config$expected_module5_version, "Module 5" )
assert_template_contains( config$module6_template, config$expected_module6_version, "Module 6" )
# 0.1 CORE NUMERIC HELPER
safe_divide <- function( numerator, denominator
) {
  result <- numerator / denominator
  result[ !is.finite( result ) ] <- NA_real_
  result
}
```

```{r module-7-sensitivity, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
write_csv_resilient <- function(x, file, ...) {
  dir.create(dirname(file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  tryCatch({
    readr::write_csv(x, file, ...)
    invisible(file)
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Unable to write output ", file, ": ", conditionMessage(e), call. = FALSE)
  })
}
```

# 4. GENERAL HELPER FUNCTIONS
normalise_r_path <- function( path
) {
  gsub( "\\\\", "/", path )
}
path_config_line <- function( name, path
) {
  paste0( name, ' = "', normalise_r_path( path ), '",' )
}
replace_once_line <- function( lines, old, new, label
) {
  matching_lines <- which( trimws( lines ) == trimws( old ) )
  # Template versions can differ in the existing RHS while retaining the same
  # configuration variable. If the exact line is absent, fall back to the
  # unique active assignment for that variable. Commented documentation lines
  # are explicitly excluded.
  if ( length( matching_lines ) == 0L
  ) {
    assignment_name <- stringr::str_match( trimws( old ), "^([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.]*)\\s*=" )[ 1, 2 ]
    if ( !is.na( assignment_name )
    ) {
      active_assignment_pattern <- paste0( "^\\s*", assignment_name, "\\s*=" )
      matching_lines <- which( !stringr::str_detect( lines,
            "^\\s*#"
          ) & stringr::str_detect( lines, active_assignment_pattern ) )
    }
  }
  if ( length( matching_lines ) != 1L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Expected exactly one active configuration line for '", label, "' but found ", length(
          matching_lines ), ". The template may have changed." ) )
  }
  line_index <- matching_lines[ 1 ]
  indentation <- stringr::str_extract( lines[ line_index ], "^\\s*" )
  lines[ line_index ] <- paste0( indentation, trimws( new ) )
  lines
}
extract_r_chunks <- function( rmd_path, r_script_path
) {
  lines <- readLines( rmd_path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8" )
  extracted_lines <- character()
  in_r_chunk <- FALSE
  chunk_count <- 0L
  for ( line in lines
  ) {
    if ( !in_r_chunk && grepl( "^\\s*```\\{r(?:[ ,}].*)?$", line )
    ) {
      in_r_chunk <- TRUE
      chunk_count <- chunk_count + 1L
      next
    }
    if ( in_r_chunk && grepl( "^\\s*```\\s*$", line )
    ) {
      in_r_chunk <- FALSE
      extracted_lines <- c( extracted_lines, "" )
      next
    }
    if ( in_r_chunk
    ) {
      extracted_lines <- c( extracted_lines, line )
    }
  }
  if ( in_r_chunk
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Unclosed R chunk detected in: ", rmd_path ) )
  }
  if ( chunk_count == 0L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "No R code chunks were found in: ", rmd_path ) )
  }
  writeLines( extracted_lines, r_script_path, useBytes = TRUE )
  invisible( list( chunk_count = chunk_count, r_lines = length( extracted_lines ) ) )
}
write_patched_case_script <- function( template_path, patched_rmd_path, r_script_path, replacements
) {
  lines <- readLines( template_path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8" )
  for ( replacement in replacements
  ) {
    lines <- replace_once_line( lines = lines, old = replacement$old, new = replacement$new, label =
          replacement$label )
  }
  writeLines( lines, patched_rmd_path, useBytes = TRUE )
  extraction_info <- extract_r_chunks( rmd_path = patched_rmd_path, r_script_path = r_script_path )
  tryCatch(
    {
      parse( file = r_script_path, keep.source = FALSE )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      stop( paste0( "Generated case script is not valid R: ", r_script_path, ". ", conditionMessage( e ) ) )
    } )
  invisible( extraction_info )
  r_script_path
}
run_script_isolated <- function( script_path, module_label
) {
  message( "    Running ", module_label, " in isolated R process..." )
  rscript_path <- file.path( R.home( "bin" ), "Rscript" )
  if ( !file.exists( rscript_path )
  ) {
    rscript_path <- Sys.which( "Rscript" )
  }
  if ( !nzchar( rscript_path ) || !file.exists( rscript_path )
  ) {
    stop( "Could not locate the Rscript executable required for isolated sensitivity runs." )
  }
  log_path <- sub( "\\.R$", "_run.log", script_path )
  original_working_directory <- getwd()
  on.exit(
    {
      setwd( original_working_directory )
      # Keep the Module 7 controller process small. All large model objects live
      # only inside the child Rscript process and disappear when it exits.
      invisible( gc( verbose = FALSE ) )
    }, add = TRUE )
  setwd( project_root )
  status <- tryCatch(
      {
        system2( command = rscript_path, args = c( "--vanilla", shQuote( script_path ) ), stdout = log_path,
          stderr = log_path )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        structure( 1L, controller_error = conditionMessage( e ) )
      } )
  if ( is.null( status )
  ) {
    status <- 0L
  }
  status <- as.integer( status )
  if ( identical( status, 0L )
  ) {
    return( list( success = TRUE, error_message = NA_character_, log_path = log_path ) )
  }
  controller_error <- attr( status, "controller_error" )
  log_tail <- character()
  if ( file.exists( log_path )
  ) {
    log_lines <- tryCatch( readLines( log_path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8" ),
        error = function(e) {
          character()
        } )
    if ( length( log_lines ) > 0L
    ) {
      log_tail <- tail( log_lines, 40L )
    }
  }
  error_text <- paste( c( if ( !is.null( controller_error )
        ) {
          controller_error
        } else {
          NULL
        }, log_tail ), collapse = "\n" )
  if ( !nzchar( error_text )
  ) {
    error_text <- paste0( "Rscript exited with status ", status, ". See log: ", log_path )
  }
  list( success = FALSE, error_message = paste0( module_label, " runtime failure in ", script_path,
        " (isolated Rscript status ", status, "): ", error_text ), log_path = log_path )
}
all_checks_pass <- function( file_path
) {
  if ( !file.exists( file_path )
  ) {
    return( FALSE )
  }
  checks <- suppressMessages( readr::read_csv( file_path, show_col_types = FALSE ) )
  if ( !"pass" %in% names( checks ) || nrow( checks ) == 0L
  ) {
    return( FALSE )
  }
  # Modules 5 and 6 deliberately include substantive diagnostic rows with
  # required_for_progress = FALSE (for example whether GAM clears the
  # complexity-selection threshold). Those are robustness RESULTS, not
  # mechanical pipeline failures. When that flag exists, only required rows
  # determine whether the module itself passed.
  if ( "required_for_progress" %in% names( checks )
  ) {
    required_flag <- as.logical( checks$required_for_progress )
    required_flag[ is.na( required_flag ) ] <- TRUE
    checks <- checks[ required_flag, , drop = FALSE ]
  }
  if ( nrow( checks ) == 0L
  ) {
    return( FALSE )
  }
  all( as.logical( checks$pass ) )
}

}
first_or_na <- function( x
) {
  if ( length( x ) == 0L
  ) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    x[ 1 ]
  }
}

```{r module-7-sensitivity, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 5. MODULE PATCHING FUNCTIONS
patch_module3 <- function( case_row, case_root
) {
  quote_market_dir <- file.path( case_root, "quote_market" )
  scripts_dir <- file.path( case_root, "scripts" )
  dir.create(
    quote_market_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE )
  dir.create(
    scripts_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE )
  patched_rmd <- file.path( scripts_dir, "03_quote_market_case.Rmd" )
  r_script <- file.path( scripts_dir, "03_quote_market_case.R" )
  replacements <- list( list( old = 'output_dir = file.path("outputs", "quote_market"),', new = path_config_line(
          "output_dir", quote_market_dir ), label = "Module 3 output_dir" ), list( old =
        'scenarios_to_run = c("baseline"),', new = paste0( 'scenarios_to_run = c("', case_row$market_scenario_id[ 1
          ], '"),' ), label = "Module 3 scenarios_to_run" ) )
  write_patched_case_script( template_path = config$module3_template, patched_rmd_path = patched_rmd,
    r_script_path = r_script, replacements = replacements )
}

patch_module5 <- function( case_row, case_root, conversion_dir
) {
  model_dir <- file.path( case_root, "conversion_models" )
  scripts_dir <- file.path( case_root, "scripts" )
  dir.create(
    model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE )
  dir.create(
    scripts_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE )
  patched_rmd <- file.path( scripts_dir, "05_conversion_models_case.Rmd" )
  r_script <- file.path( scripts_dir, "05_conversion_models_case.R" )
  replacements <- list( list( old = 'input_dir = file.path("outputs", "conversion_generation"),', new =
        path_config_line( "input_dir", conversion_dir ), label = "Module 5 input_dir" ), list( old =
        'output_dir = file.path("outputs", "conversion_models"),', new = path_config_line( "output_dir", model_dir
        ), label = "Module 5 output_dir" ), list( old = 'market_scenario_id = "baseline",', new = paste0(
          'market_scenario_id = "', case_row$market_scenario_id[ 1 ], '",' ), label = "Module 5 market_scenario_id"
    ), list( old = 'demand_scenario_id = "baseline",', new = paste0( 'demand_scenario_id = "',
          case_row$demand_scenario_id[ 1 ], '",' ), label = "Module 5 demand_scenario_id" ) )
  generated_script <- write_patched_case_script( template_path = config$module5_template, patched_rmd_path =
        patched_rmd, r_script_path = r_script, replacements = replacements )
  # In Module 7, final TEST O/E and calibration slope are robustness outcomes,
  # not mechanical reasons to abort a sensitivity case before Module 6.
  parse( file = generated_script, keep.source = FALSE )
  generated_script
}

        paste0( "minimum_unit_margin_retention = ", format( case_row$minimum_unit_margin_retention[ 1 ],
            nsmall = 2, trim = TRUE ), "," ), label = "Module 6 minimum_unit_margin_retention" ), list( old =
        'targeted_rate_level_lower = 0.995,', new = paste0( "targeted_rate_level_lower = ", format(
            case_row$targeted_rate_level_lower[ 1 ], nsmall = 3, trim = TRUE ), "," ), label =
        "Module 6 targeted_rate_level_lower" ), list( old = 'targeted_rate_level_upper = 1.005,', new = paste0(
          "targeted_rate_level_upper = ", format( case_row$targeted_rate_level_upper[ 1 ], nsmall = 3, trim = TRUE
          ), "," ), label = "Module 6 targeted_rate_level_upper" ) )
  write_patched_case_script( template_path = config$module6_template, patched_rmd_path = patched_rmd,
    r_script_path = r_script, replacements = replacements )
}
```

```{r module-7-sensitivity, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 6. RUN SENSITIVITY CASES
case_status_rows <- list()
baseline_root <- file.path( config$cases_dir, "baseline" )
baseline_quote_dir <- file.path( baseline_root, "quote_market" )
baseline_conversion_dir <- file.path( baseline_root, "conversion_generation" )
baseline_model_dir <- file.path( baseline_root, "conversion_models" )
for ( case_index in seq_len( nrow( scenario_register ) )
) {
  case_row <- scenario_register[ case_index, ]
  case_id <- case_row$case_id[ 1 ]
  scenario_group <- case_row$scenario_group[ 1 ]
  case_root <- file.path( config$cases_dir, case_id )
  message( "" )
  message( "============================================================" )
  message( "Sensitivity case ", case_row$case_order[ 1 ], ": ", case_id )
  message( case_row$scenario_description[ 1 ] )
  message( "============================================================" )
  # Demand and pricing cases depend on baseline outputs.
  if ( case_id != "baseline" && scenario_group %in% c( "Demand", "Pricing rule" )
  ) {
    baseline_status <- case_status_rows[[ "baseline" ]]
    if ( is.null( baseline_status ) || !isTRUE( baseline_status$case_success[ 1 ] )
    ) {
      message( "  Skipped because the baseline dependency did not complete successfully." )
      case_status_rows[[ case_id ]] <- tibble( case_id = case_id, case_success = FALSE, module_failed =
            "Baseline dependency", error_message = "Skipped because baseline case outputs were unavailable.",
          reused_existing_outputs = FALSE )
      next
    }
  }
  dir.create(
    case_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE )
  if ( !config$overwrite_existing_cases && case_complete( case_root )
  ) {
    message( "  Existing completed case found; reusing outputs." )
    case_status_rows[[ case_id ]] <- tibble( case_id = case_id, case_success = TRUE, module_failed = NA_character_,
        error_message = NA_character_, reused_existing_outputs = TRUE )
    next
  }
  case_success <- TRUE
  module_failed <- NA_character_
  error_message <- NA_character_
  # 6.1 Resolve / run Module 3
  if ( case_id == "baseline" || scenario_group == "Market structure"
  ) {
    quote_market_dir <- file.path( case_root, "quote_market" )
    module3_script <- tryCatch( patch_module3( case_row = case_row, case_root = case_root ),
        error = function(e) {
          e
        } )
    if ( inherits( module3_script, "error" )
    ) {
      case_success <- FALSE
      module_failed <- "Module 3 patch/parse"
      error_message <- conditionMessage( module3_script )
    } else {
      result3 <- run_script_isolated( script_path = module3_script, module_label = "Module 3" )
      if ( !result3$success
      ) {
        case_success <- FALSE
        module_failed <- "Module 3"
        error_message <- result3$error_message
      }
    }
  } else {
    quote_market_dir <- baseline_quote_dir
  }
  # 6.2 Resolve / run Module 4
  if ( case_success
  ) {
    if ( case_id == "baseline" || scenario_group %in% c( "Market structure", "Demand" )
    ) {
      conversion_dir <- file.path( case_root, "conversion_generation" )
      module4_script <- tryCatch( patch_module4( case_row = case_row, case_root = case_root, quote_market_dir =
              quote_market_dir ),
          error = function(e) {
            e
          } )
      if ( inherits( module4_script, "error" )
      ) {
        case_success <- FALSE
        module_failed <- "Module 4 patch/parse"
        error_message <- conditionMessage( module4_script )
      } else {
        result4 <- run_script_isolated( script_path = module4_script, module_label = "Module 4" )
        if ( !result4$success
        ) {
          case_success <- FALSE
          module_failed <- "Module 4"
          error_message <- result4$error_message
        }
      }
    } else {
      conversion_dir <- baseline_conversion_dir
    }
  }
  # 6.3 Resolve / run Module 5
  if ( case_success
  ) {
    if ( case_id == "baseline" || scenario_group %in% c( "Market structure", "Demand" )
    ) {
      model_dir <- file.path( case_root, "conversion_models" )
      module5_script <- tryCatch( patch_module5( case_row = case_row, case_root = case_root, conversion_dir =
              conversion_dir ),
          error = function(e) {
            e
          } )
      if ( inherits( module5_script, "error" )
      ) {
        case_success <- FALSE
        module_failed <- "Module 5 patch/parse"
        error_message <- conditionMessage( module5_script )
      } else {
        result5 <- run_script_isolated( script_path = module5_script, module_label = "Module 5" )
        if ( !result5$success
        ) {
          case_success <- FALSE
          module_failed <- "Module 5"
          error_message <- result5$error_message
        }
      }
    } else {
      model_dir <- baseline_model_dir
    }
  }
  # 6.4 Run Module 6 for every case
  if ( case_success
  ) {
    module6_script <- tryCatch( patch_module6( case_row = case_row, case_root = case_root, quote_market_dir =
            quote_market_dir, conversion_dir = conversion_dir, model_dir = model_dir ),
        error = function(e) {
          e
        } )
    if ( inherits( module6_script, "error" )
    ) {
      case_success <- FALSE
      module_failed <- "Module 6 patch/parse"
      error_message <- conditionMessage( module6_script )
    } else {
      result6 <- run_script_isolated( script_path = module6_script, module_label = "Module 6" )
      if ( !result6$success
      ) {
        case_success <- FALSE
        module_failed <- "Module 6"
        error_message <- result6$error_message
      }
    }
  }
  # 6.5 Save case status
  case_status_rows[[ case_id ]] <- tibble( case_id = case_id, case_success = case_success, module_failed =
        module_failed, error_message = error_message, reused_existing_outputs = FALSE )
  if ( !case_success
  ) {
    warning( paste0( "Sensitivity case '", case_id, "' failed in ", module_failed,
        ". The runner will continue to later independent cases." ) )
  }
}
```

```{r module-7-sensitivity, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 8. COLLECT CASE RESULTS
collect_case_results <- function( case_row, status_row
) {
  case_id <- case_row$case_id[ 1 ]
  case_root <- file.path( config$cases_dir, case_id )
  if ( !isTRUE( status_row$case_success[ 1 ] )
  ) {
    return( tibble( case_id = case_id, collection_success = FALSE ) )
  }
  pricing_dir <- file.path( case_root, "pricing_simulation" )
  if ( case_row$scenario_group[ 1 ] == "Pricing rule"
  ) {
    # Pricing-rule cases reuse the entire frozen baseline Modules 3-5.
    quote_dir <- baseline_quote_dir
    conversion_dir <- baseline_conversion_dir
    model_dir <- baseline_model_dir
  } else if ( case_row$scenario_group[ 1 ] == "Demand"
  ) {
    # Demand cases reuse the baseline Module 3 quote market, but have their own
    # Module 4 conversion generation and Module 5 fitted conversion models.
    quote_dir <- baseline_quote_dir
    conversion_dir <- file.path( case_root, "conversion_generation" )
    model_dir <- file.path( case_root, "conversion_models" )
  } else {
    # Baseline and market-structure cases have case-specific Modules 3-5.
    quote_dir <- file.path( case_root, "quote_market" )
    conversion_dir <- file.path( case_root, "conversion_generation" )
    model_dir <- file.path( case_root, "conversion_models" )
  }
  required_files <- c( file.path( pricing_dir, "test_strategy_comparison.csv" ), file.path( pricing_dir,
      "selected_segment_multipliers.csv" ), file.path( pricing_dir, "targeted_strategy_selection_summary.csv" ),
    file.path( pricing_dir, "pricing_validation_checks.csv" ), file.path( model_dir,
      "final_selected_test_metrics.csv" ), file.path( model_dir, "incremental_model_value.csv" ), file.path(
      model_dir, "truth_probability_recovery.csv" ), file.path( model_dir, "full_model_selection_table.csv" ),
    file.path( pricing_dir, "selected_conversion_model_interface.csv" ), file.path( pricing_dir,
      "prediction_interface_reconstruction.csv" ), file.path( pricing_dir, "neutral_targeted_feasibility.csv" ),
    file.path( pricing_dir, "pricing_sample_architecture.csv" ) )
  missing_files <- required_files[ !file.exists( required_files ) ]
  if ( length( missing_files ) > 0L
  ) {
    warning( paste0( "Missing collected output(s) for sensitivity case ", case_id, ": ", paste( missing_files,
          collapse = "; " ) ) )
    return( tibble( case_id = case_id, collection_success = FALSE ) )
  }
  strategy_comparison <- readr::read_csv( file.path( pricing_dir, "test_strategy_comparison.csv" ),
      show_col_types = FALSE )
  segment_multipliers <- readr::read_csv( file.path( pricing_dir, "selected_segment_multipliers.csv" ),
      show_col_types = FALSE )
  targeted_selection <- readr::read_csv( file.path( pricing_dir, "targeted_strategy_selection_summary.csv" ),
      show_col_types = FALSE )
  final_model_metrics <- readr::read_csv( file.path( model_dir, "final_selected_test_metrics.csv" ),
      show_col_types = FALSE )
  incremental_value <- readr::read_csv( file.path( model_dir, "incremental_model_value.csv" ),
      show_col_types = FALSE )
  truth_recovery <- readr::read_csv( file.path( model_dir, "truth_probability_recovery.csv" ),
      show_col_types = FALSE )
  full_model_selection <- readr::read_csv( file.path( model_dir, "full_model_selection_table.csv" ),
      show_col_types = FALSE )
  selected_model_interface <- readr::read_csv( file.path( pricing_dir, "selected_conversion_model_interface.csv" ),
      show_col_types = FALSE )
  prediction_interface_reconstruction <- readr::read_csv( file.path( pricing_dir,
        "prediction_interface_reconstruction.csv" ), show_col_types = FALSE )
  neutral_targeted_feasibility <- readr::read_csv( file.path( pricing_dir, "neutral_targeted_feasibility.csv" ),
      show_col_types = FALSE )
  pricing_sample_architecture <- readr::read_csv( file.path( pricing_dir, "pricing_sample_architecture.csv" ),
      show_col_types = FALSE )
  if ( nrow( pricing_sample_architecture ) != 1L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "pricing_sample_architecture.csv must contain exactly one row for case ", case_id, "." ) )
  }
  required_strategy_names <- c( "Technical-pricing benchmark", "Own-price uniform strategy",
    "Market-position uniform strategy", "Market-position targeted strategy" )
  missing_strategy_names <- setdiff( required_strategy_names, strategy_comparison$strategy )
  if ( length( missing_strategy_names ) > 0L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Strategy comparison is missing required row(s) for case ", case_id, ": ", paste(
          missing_strategy_names, collapse = ", " ) ) )

  own_price <- strategy_comparison %>% filter( strategy == "Own-price uniform strategy" )
  market_uniform <- strategy_comparison %>% filter( strategy == "Market-position uniform strategy" )
  targeted <- strategy_comparison %>% filter( strategy == "Market-position targeted strategy" )
  selected_model_name <- final_model_metrics$model[ 1 ]

  own_truth <- truth_recovery %>% filter( model == "Own-price GLM" )

    selected_model_interface$selected_model_type[ 1 ] %in% config$expected_conversion_model_families
  selected_model_interface_max_difference <- prediction_interface_reconstruction %>% filter( difference_scale ==
        "probability", model == selected_model_name ) %>% pull( max_absolute_difference )
  original_price_reconstruction_max_difference <- prediction_interface_reconstruction %>% filter( model ==
        "Original focal quote" ) %>% pull( max_absolute_difference )
  multiplier_summary <- segment_multipliers %>% summarise( targeted_multiplier_min = min( selected_multiplier ),
      targeted_multiplier_max = max( selected_multiplier ), targeted_multiplier_mean = mean( selected_multiplier ),
      targeted_multiplier_sd = sd( selected_multiplier ), targeted_multiplier_range = max( selected_multiplier ) -
        min( selected_multiplier ), targeted_distinct_multipliers = n_distinct( selected_multiplier ) )
  market_checks_path <- file.path( quote_dir, "quote_market_validation_checks.csv" )
  conversion_checks_path <- file.path( conversion_dir, "conversion_generation_validation_checks.csv" )
  model_checks_path <- file.path( model_dir, "model_validation_checks.csv" )
  pricing_checks_path <- file.path( pricing_dir, "pricing_validation_checks.csv" )
  market_checks_pass <- all_checks_pass( market_checks_path )
  conversion_checks_pass <- all_checks_pass( conversion_checks_path )
  model_checks_pass <- all_checks_pass( model_checks_path )
  pricing_checks_pass <- all_checks_pass( pricing_checks_path )
  all_pipeline_checks_pass <- all( market_checks_pass, conversion_checks_pass, model_checks_pass,

  architecture_contract_pass <- nrow( pricing_sample_architecture ) == 1L && as.integer(

        pricing_sample_architecture$technical_data_split[ 1 ] ), "test" ) && as.integer(

  selected_segmentation_id <- targeted_selection$selected_segmentation_id[ 1 ]
  selected_segmentation_name <- targeted_selection$selected_segmentation_name[ 1 ]
  selected_segmentation_category <- targeted_selection$selected_segmentation_category[ 1 ]
  selected_source_variable <- targeted_selection$selected_source_variable[ 1 ]
  selected_number_segments <- targeted_selection$selected_number_segments[ 1 ]
  tibble( case_id = case_id, collection_success = TRUE, scenario_group = case_row$scenario_group[ 1 ],
    scenario_description = case_row$scenario_description[ 1 ], market_scenario_id = case_row$market_scenario_id[ 1
```

```{r module-7-sensitivity, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
baseline_selected_model <- baseline_summary$selected_conversion_model[ 1 ]
baseline_targeting_segmentation <- baseline_summary$selected_targeting_segmentation_id[ 1 ]
sensitivity_summary <- sensitivity_summary %>% mutate( development_rate_neutral_pass = collection_success & abs(
        targeted_development_rate_level - 1 ) <= config$development_rate_neutral_tolerance + 1e-12,
    truth_conversion_improvement_pass = collection_success & targeted_true_conversion_uplift_pp >
        config$minimum_truth_conversion_uplift, truth_margin_preservation_pass = collection_success &
      targeted_true_margin_retention + 1e-12 >= config$minimum_truth_margin_retention,
    market_information_recovery_gain_pass = collection_success & truth_recovery_spearman_gain > 0,
    market_information_logloss_gain_pass = collection_success & selected_log_loss_improvement_vs_own_price > 0,
    selected_model_interface_pass = collection_success & selected_model_interface_max_probability_difference <=
        1e-8, neutral_targeted_feasibility_pass = collection_success & neutral_targeted_strategy_feasible,
    gam_material_improvement = collection_success & gam_complexity_threshold_met &
      gam_validation_calibration_acceptable, predictive_conclusion_stable = collection_success &
      all_pipeline_checks_pass & architecture_contract_pass & module5_contract_pass &
      selected_model_interface_pass & market_information_recovery_gain_pass & market_information_logloss_gain_pass,
    pricing_conclusion_stable = collection_success & all_pipeline_checks_pass & architecture_contract_pass &
      module5_contract_pass & selected_model_interface_pass & neutral_targeted_feasibility_pass &
      development_rate_neutral_pass & truth_conversion_improvement_pass & truth_margin_preservation_pass,
    central_conclusion_stable = predictive_conclusion_stable & pricing_conclusion_stable,
    selected_model_same_as_baseline = collection_success & selected_conversion_model == baseline_selected_model,
    targeting_basis_same_as_baseline = collection_success & selected_targeting_segmentation_id ==
        baseline_targeting_segmentation, targeted_true_uplift_change_vs_baseline =
      targeted_true_relative_conversion_uplift - baseline_truth_relative_conversion_uplift,
    targeted_true_margin_change_vs_baseline = targeted_true_margin_retention - baseline_truth_margin_retention,
    targeted_mean_multiplier_change_vs_baseline = targeted_multiplier_mean - baseline_targeted_mean_multiplier )
write_csv_resilient( sensitivity_summary, file.path( config$output_dir, "sensitivity_summary.csv" ) )
```

```{r module-7-sensitivity, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 13. DETAILED SELECTED MULTIPLIERS ACROSS CASES
multiplier_case_rows <- list()
for ( case_id in successful_summary$case_id
) {
  case_row <- scenario_register %>% filter( case_id == .env$case_id )
  multiplier_path <- file.path( config$cases_dir, case_id, "pricing_simulation", "selected_segment_multipliers.csv"
    )
  if ( file.exists( multiplier_path )
  ) {
    case_multipliers <- readr::read_csv( multiplier_path, show_col_types = FALSE )
    required_multiplier_fields <- c( "segmentation_id", "segmentation_name", "segmentation_category",
      "source_variable", "pricing_segment", "selected_multiplier" )
    missing_multiplier_fields <- setdiff( required_multiplier_fields, names( case_multipliers ) )
    if ( length( missing_multiplier_fields ) > 0L
    ) {
      stop( paste0( "selected_segment_multipliers.csv is missing required field(s) for case ", case_id, ": ",
          paste( missing_multiplier_fields, collapse = ", " ) ) )
    }
    multiplier_case_rows[[ case_id ]] <- case_multipliers %>% mutate( case_id = .env$case_id, scenario_group =
          case_row$scenario_group[ 1 ], case_order = case_row$case_order[ 1 ], .before = 1 )
  }
}
selected_multipliers_all_cases <- bind_rows( multiplier_case_rows )
if ( nrow( selected_multipliers_all_cases ) > 0L
) {
  baseline_multipliers <- selected_multipliers_all_cases %>% filter( case_id == "baseline" ) %>% dplyr::select(
      segmentation_id, pricing_segment, baseline_selected_multiplier = selected_multiplier )
  selected_multipliers_all_cases <- selected_multipliers_all_cases %>% left_join( baseline_multipliers, by = c(
          "segmentation_id", "pricing_segment" ) ) %>% mutate( comparable_to_baseline_segment = !is.na(
          baseline_selected_multiplier ), multiplier_change_vs_baseline = if_else( comparable_to_baseline_segment,
          selected_multiplier - baseline_selected_multiplier, NA_real_ ) ) %>% arrange( case_order,
      segmentation_id, pricing_segment )
  write_csv_resilient( selected_multipliers_all_cases, file.path( config$output_dir,
      "selected_multipliers_all_cases.csv" ) )
}
```

```{r module-7-sensitivity, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 17. DIAGNOSTIC PLOTS
if ( isTRUE( config$write_plots )
) {
  plot_summary <- sensitivity_summary %>% filter( collection_success ) %>% mutate( case_label = factor( case_id,
          levels = rev( case_id[ order( case_order ) ] ) ) )

  p_true_conversion_uplift <- ggplot( plot_summary, aes( x = case_label, y =

    coord_flip() + labs( x = NULL, y = "True relative conversion uplift",
      title = "Targeted-strategy conversion uplift across sensitivity cases" ) + theme_minimal()
  ggsave( file.path( config$output_dir, "01_true_conversion_uplift_by_case.png" ), p_true_conversion_uplift,
    width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300 )
  # 17.2 True margin retention
  p_true_margin_retention <- ggplot( plot_summary, aes( x = case_label, y = targeted_true_margin_retention ) ) +
    geom_col() + geom_hline( yintercept = 1, linetype = 2 ) + coord_flip() + labs( x = NULL,
      y = "True underwriting-margin retention", title = "Targeted-strategy true margin retention" ) +
    theme_minimal()
  ggsave( file.path( config$output_dir, "02_true_margin_retention_by_case.png" ), p_true_margin_retention,
    width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300 )
  # 17.3 Market-position recovery gain
  p_market_information_gain <- ggplot( plot_summary, aes( x = case_label, y = truth_recovery_spearman_gain ) ) +
    geom_col() + geom_hline( yintercept = 0, linetype = 2 ) + coord_flip() + labs( x = NULL,
      y = "Spearman recovery gain over Own-price GLM",
      title = "Incremental truth recovery from market-position information" ) + theme_minimal()
  ggsave( file.path( config$output_dir, "03_market_information_truth_gain.png" ), p_market_information_gain,
    width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300 )
  # 17.4 Selected conversion-model family
  p_selected_model_family <- ggplot( plot_summary, aes( x = case_label, y = selected_conversion_model_type ) ) +
    geom_point( size = 3 ) + coord_flip() + labs( x = NULL, y = "Selected model family",
      title = "Selected conversion-model family across sensitivity cases" ) + theme_minimal()
  ggsave( file.path( config$output_dir, "04_selected_conversion_model_family.png" ), p_selected_model_family,
    width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300 )
  # 17.5 Targeted multiplier profiles

            levels = unique( pricing_segment ) ) ) %>% ggplot( aes( x = pricing_segment, y = selected_multiplier,
          group = 1 ) ) + geom_line() + geom_point() + facet_wrap( vars( case_id, segmentation_name ), scales =
          "free_x" ) + labs( x = "Selected pricing segment", y = "Selected multiplier",
        title = "Validation-selected targeted pricing pattern across sensitivity cases" ) + theme_minimal() +
      theme( axis.text.x = element_text( angle = 45, hjust = 1 ) )
    ggsave( file.path( config$output_dir, "05_targeted_multiplier_profiles.png" ), p_multiplier_profiles,
      width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 300 )
  }
  # 17.6 Selected targeting basis
  p_targeting_basis <- ggplot( plot_summary, aes( x = case_label, y = selected_targeting_segmentation_name ) ) +
    geom_point( size = 3 ) + coord_flip() + labs( x = NULL, y = "Validation-selected targeting basis",
      title = "Selected targeting basis across sensitivity cases" ) + theme_minimal()
  ggsave( file.path( config$output_dir, "06_selected_targeting_basis.png" ), p_targeting_basis, width = 10,
    height = 6, dpi = 300 )
}
```
